posts.title: A desk set-up you can check in five minutes
posts.excerpt: Most desk problems are small and fixable in five minutes: screen height, elbow angle, a supported lower back and a reminder to stand.
posts.content:
Most desk problems are small and fixable in five minutes, long before anyone needs a clinic. Sit down the way you normally do, and look at the set-up from the side rather than the front: the top of the screen should sit at about eye height, your elbows near a right angle, your feet flat and the chair supporting the curve of your lower back.

If the screen sits low, a riser or a stack of books is enough. If your wrists bend upward to reach the keyboard, lower the chair or raise the desk. Then set a reminder to stand up every forty minutes: the aim is not a perfect posture, but not staying in one position all day. Bring a photo of your set-up to a first visit and we will go through it with you.
